rationale: C15 is the immediately preceding proclamation in the same supplementing series and supplies the child's concrete two-part drafting architecture: recitals identifying newly effective contracting parties, a determination that previously withheld Schedule XX concessions should be applied, corresponding removal of those concessions from the December 16 withholding list, application of their duty rates subject to the same agreements and qualifications, and amendment of the January 1 Cuban-agreement list. The child closely reproduces C15's distinctive operative language while substituting new governments, dates, concessions, and Cuban-list deletions. C24 and C16 also use substantially the same tariff machinery, but C15 is the closest and most complete template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: each of the concessions provided for in part I of said schedule XX which are identified in the 6th recital of this proclamation shall, on and after the date set forth following the identification of each such concession, no longer be identified in the 8th recital of said proclamation of December 16, 1947
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Each of the concessions provided for in part I of said schedule XX which are identified in the 6th recital of this proclamation shall, on and after the date set forth following the identification of each such concession, no longer be identified in the 8th recital of said proclamation of December 16, 1947
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces nearly verbatim C15's distinctive mechanism for activating previously withheld Schedule XX concessions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the rate of duty representing each such concession ... shall be applied, subject to the applicable terms, conditions, and qualifications set forth in said schedule XX, and parts I, II, and III, of said general agreement, and in subdivision (a), other than exception (I) thereof, of said proclamation of December 16, 1947
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the rate of duty representing each such concession ... shall be applied, subject to the applicable terms, conditions, and qualifications set forth in said schedule XX, and parts I, II, and III, of said general agreement, and in subdivision (a), other than exception (I) thereof, of said proclamation of December 16, 1947
shared_material.explanation: This long, particular chain of incorporated terms and qualifications is shared verbatim and is material operative machinery rather than generic proclamation boilerplate.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the list set forth in the 9th recital of said proclamation of January 1, 1948, as amended and rectified, shall be further amended in the manner, and on and after the respective dates, indicated in the 7th recital of this proclamation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The list set forth in the 9th recital of said proclamation of January 1, 1948, as amended and rectified, shall be further amended in the manner, and on and after the respective dates, indicated in the 9th recital of this proclamation
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same cross-referenced amendment mechanism for the Cuban exclusive-trade-agreement list, with only the recital number and substantive amendments changed.
